appraisal_events.evidence: Il est vivant, qu'est-ce qu'on veut de plus?... j'en ai tant pris que je l'ai encore sur l'estomac. Cela n'empêche qu'on ne viendra pas prendre de mes nouvelles comme de mon cher Amanien... On le tue, cet homme, en envoyant tout le temps chez lui.
appraisal_events.explanation: The duke's rambling sympathy for his dying cousin veers into a complaint about his own indigestion, and he rationalizes his own reluctance to inquire further as concern for the patient's rest, exposing him as self-absorbed and hypocritical even while performing solicitude.

status_effects.explanation: The duke's comic self-centeredness and hypocritical rationalization for avoiding his dying relative sharply undercut his professed concern.
